finding.description: [LLM-Judge] Token introspection returned HTTP 200 even though no exchanged token was obtained (subject_token empty), suggesting introspection endpoint may not be validating required inputs or is returning success on error.

sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: A token exchange must not allow a subject_token issued for client-A to be used to mint a token for client-B unless broker policy explicitly allows it; effective permissions must remain bounded to the upstream intent of the subject_token.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Token exchange allowed a client-A subject_token to mint a usable token for client-B (cross-client authorization binding failure).
